subclassFeature.name: Radiant Sun Disciple
entries: Monks of the Soul Adept tradition learn to awaken the radiant power within their own spirits. They channel that energy through their bodies, wreathing their strikes in fire and brilliant light or releasing it as searing blasts across the battlefield. To these warriors, the sun is more than a symbol—it is a source of discipline, clarity, and overwhelming force.
Your discipline awakens the light of the sun within your spirit. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Flame Warden
entries: You know the {@spell control flames|XGE} cantrip. You can cast it as a Bonus Action, and when you cast it in this way, it can affect magical or nonmagical flames.

Additionally, as a Bonus Action, choose one magical or nonmagical source of light that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. For 1 hour, the radii of Bright Light and Dim Light produced by that source are doubled. You can end this effect on a source early as a Bonus Action. The effect ends early if the source stops producing light.

entries.name: Radiant Sun Technique
entries: You can use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. When you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Wisdom modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity to determine the saving throw.
Whenever you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike or with a magical Monk feature, you can cause the damage to be Fire or Radiant damage instead of its normal damage type.

When you make an Unarmed Strike to deal damage, you can instead project a bolt of solar energy at one creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Make a ranged spell attack against the target, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. On a hit, the target takes Fire or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. This attack counts as an Unarmed Strike for your Monk features, including Flurry of Blows and Stunning Strike, but is a ranged attack rather than a melee attack. You cannot use this bolt to Grapple or Shove, and it cannot be used for an Opportunity Attack.

subclassFeature.name: Flames of the Sun Soul
entries: You can expend 2 Focus Points to cast {@spell burning hands|XPHB} at level 2 as a Bonus Action, or to cast {@spell flaming sphere|XPHB} at level 2 as a Magic action. You do not need to provide Verbal or Material components when casting either spell with this feature. When you cast either spell with this feature, you can expend up to 3 additional Focus Points. The spell's level increases by 1 for each additional Focus Point expended, to a maximum spell level of 5. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and their saving throw DC equals your Monk Focus save DC. You must maintain Concentration on Flaming Sphere as normal.

subclassFeature.name: Searing Sunburst
entries: As a Magic action, you create a brilliant orb of solar energy and hurl it at a point you can see within 300 feet of yourself. The orb erupts into a 20-foot-radius Sphere of searing light.

Each creature in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your Monk Focus save DC, taking Fire damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A creature behind opaque Total Cover from the point of origin is unaffected by this feature.
When you use this feature, you can expend up to 3 Focus Points. For each Focus Point expended, the damage increases by two rolls of your Martial Arts die.

subclassFeature.name: Solar Crown
entries: As a Bonus Action, you manifest an aura of sunlight around yourself for 1 minute. For the duration, you shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. This light counts as sunlight. While this aura is active, you have Resistance to Radiant and Cold damage. Each time you hit with an Unarmed Strike, the strike deals extra Fire or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die.

Whenever a creature within 10 feet of you deals damage to you, that creature takes Fire or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die. This damage requires no action or Reaction.
Once you activate this feature without expending Focus Points, you cannot do so again in this way until you finish a Long Rest. You can activate it again by expending 4 Focus Points.
